answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents mint unique identities by anchoring a zero-knowledge proof of hardware identity to cryptographic attestation chains. Verified agents trade across a liquidity lagoon, while rogue identities are exiled to an economic tundra. Each verification request requires a verifiable cipher challenge and staking bonds scaled superlinearly with O(k^2) costs, creating exponential capital exhaustion for any Sybil swarm.
